propositions: A ticket with a live `supersedes` or `duplicates` link cannot be closed via administrative disposition because the plan-review close gate does not receive the close_class parameter and therefore cannot exempt link-backed administrative dispositions.

The gate function close_plan_review_gate_check unconditionally demands a plan-review attestation for task/story/epic tickets, even when a verifiable replacement link exists that would satisfy the disposition evidence standard already applied by the completion gate.
The only workaround is `--force` close, which records no signed attestation and degrades the audit trail for a disposition that is administrative and evidence-backed.

Superseded tickets with legitimate replacement links are constructed such that review-plan will always block (the work already exists elsewhere), making the attestation requirement unsatisfiable by design.

The fix threads close_class and tracker parameters into the gate, reuses the existing _has_live_replacement_link predicate, and exempts only link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) when live evidence exists.
Force-closing a legitimately superseded child ticket strips the completion signature from its entire ancestor epic chain, preventing that epic from earning attestation.
